name: apple-reminders
title: Apple Reminders
description: Apple Reminders: smart-list tiles (Today, Scheduled, All, Flagged, Completed) with live counts, colored lists with sections, circular checkboxes that spring filled, inline add, a details sheet (notes, date and time, flag, priority, subtasks), show/clear completed, search, and a small burst when a list is cleared. Sidebar and list side by side on wide screens; the lists screen pushes the list on phones. Large list titles fold into the bar as you scroll; tints with each list's color, light and dark.
